photo.title: Portrait of Illchamus (Njemps) woman from a settlement 12 miles north of Marigat, Kenya, wearing a brown robe tied across the middle with a silver plated belt. On her arms and wrists she is wearing large silver coil bracelets, around her neck is a necklace made of coils of pink beads. The woman's ear lobes are pierced with a long beaded decorative strip, and the top of her ear is pierced with an ivory thorn.

Portrait of Illchamus (Njemps) woman from a settlement 12 miles north of Marigat, Kenya, wearing a brown robe. Around her neck is a necklace made of coils of pink beads. The woman's ear lobes are pierced with a long beaded decorative strip, and the top of her ear is pierced with an ivory thorn.

Portrait of a Illchamus (Njemps) man, from 12 miles north of Marigat, Kenya. His hair is braided and dyed with red ochre and black tips with a headband securing it in place. His ear lobes are pierced and are folded over the tops of his ears. Around his neck he is wearing orange and red beaded necklaces.

A Illchamus (Njemps) man and woman walking along a track near a settlement 12 miles north of Marigat, Kenya. They are both wearing brown robes. The man's hair is braided and dyed with red ochre and is carrying a wooden beater under one arm. The woman is carrying a hide bag and a stick. She is wearing large silver coil bracelets around her writs and arms and around her neck is a necklace made of coils of pink beads.

arms.title: Quiver made of cane and leather, containing arrows. Hollow, length of cane, with leather cap at either end and a long leather strap held in place by brass wire fittings; contains an unknown number of arrows possibly coated in poison and a possible firestick.

Quiver made of cane and leather, containing arrows. Hollow, length of cane, with leather cap at either end and a long leather strap decorated with two cowries; contains an unknown number of notched arrows fletched with feathers, and possibly coated in poison.
